item.title: Bret McKenzie Announces Australian Tour For March 2026
item.description: Grammy-winning musician Bret McKenzie is bringing his solo material and classic hits from Flight of the Conchords to Australia in March 2026.

item.title: Blake Shelton Scores 31st Country Radio Number One With Stay Country Or Die Tryin’
item.description: Blake Shelton scores his 31st country radio number one with “Stay Country or Die Tryin’” as he launches his Las Vegas residency at Caesars Palace.

item.title: Goose Announce Highly Anticipated Return To Madison Square Garden
item.description: Goose return to Madison Square Garden for a two-night headline run in June 2026, following their sold-out 2025 debut at the iconic venue.

item.title: Jack White Releases Landmark Anthology With Collected Lyrics And Writings
item.description: Jack White has released Collected Lyrics and Selected Writing Volume 1, an anthology spanning his career with exclusive poems, essays, and rare photos

item.title: Live It Up: The Mental As Anything Story Hits Cinemas In March 2026 As Band Reforms For 50th Anniversary Tour
item.description: The definitive documentary on Mental As Anything arrives in cinemas in March 2026, coinciding with the band’s reformation and 50th anniversary national tour.

item.title: BTS Announce Monumental Return With 2026-2027 Global Stadium Tour
item.description: BTS will return to the global stage in 2026 with a massive stadium world tour spanning 79 shows across 34 regions, including Australia.

item.title: Poison The Well Announce New Album Peace In Place After 16 Year Hiatus
item.description: Poison The Well have announced Peace In Place, their first new album in over 16 years, arriving March 20 via SharpTone Records, alongside the new single Thoroughbreds.

item.title: Gordi Shares New Single High Line And Announces Australian Headline Tour
item.description: Gordi launches 2026 with new single High Line and announces an 11-date Australian headline tour following her acclaimed album Like Plasticine.

item.title: Yungblud Proves Rock Still Has a Future: Live at Melbourne’s Sidney Myer Music Bowl
item.description: Yungblud’s Melbourne show at Sidney Myer Music Bowl was a powerful reminder that rock still matters. Big songs, massive production, and a genuine connection with fans.

item.title: Frampton Comes Alive Turns 50 As A Live Album That Changed Rock History
item.description: Peter Frampton’s Frampton Comes Alive turns 50, marking the live album that transformed his career and became one of the most successful records of the 1970s.
